verdict.rationale: Sill's own README documents clipboard sync in both directions: text copied on the Mac is ready to paste on the device, and 'Paste in Sill' sends the device's clipboard to the Mac. Nothing in the evidence shows a setting to turn clipboard sharing off, so the control half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a documented toggle to disable clipboard sync, clipboard content types beyond text, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
